title: John Deere Recalls Tractor Backhoe Attachments Due to Crushing Hazard (Recall Alert)
summary: The mounting hardware could loosen and cause the backhoe frame to rotate toward the operator, posing a crushing hazard. Units: About 50.

title: KTM North America Recalls Motocross Competition Off-Road Motorcycles Due to Crash Hazard
summary: The connecting rod in the crankshaft assembly can fracture, causing the operator to lose control of the motorcycle and crash. Units: About 920.

title: Polaris Recalls RZR XP Turbo Recreational Off-Highway Vehicles Due to Fire Hazard; Severe Burn Injuries; Includes Previously Recalled RZR Turbo ROVs
summary: The vehicles' engine can overheat and turbo system's drain tube can loosen, posing a fire hazard. Units: About 13,000 (including the 2,230 vehicles previously recalled on December 2015).

title: SAHN Designs Recalls Bicycle Helmets Due to Risk of Head Injury
summary: The helmets do not comply with the impact requirements of the federal safety standard for bicycle helmets, posing a risk of head injury. Units: About 2,000 (in addition, about 1,600 were sold in Canada).

title: Bungee Chairs Sold Exclusively at Big 5 Sporting Goods Stores Recalled Due to Fall Hazard; Made by Nanjing Kekang Outdoor Products
summary: The chair rivets can break while in use, posing a fall hazard to the consumer. Units: About 4,100.

title: GE Appliances Recalls Top-Loading Clothes Washers Due to Fire Hazard
summary: An electrical component in the washers can overheat, posing a fire hazard. Units: About 222,000 (in addition, about 450 were sold in Canada).

title: Polaris Recalls Ranger Recreational Off-Highway Vehicles Due to Fire and Burn Hazards
summary: The heat shield can fall off the vehicle, posing fire and burn hazards to riders. Units: About 42,500.

title: Samsung Recalls Galaxy Note7 Smartphones Due to Serious Fire and Burn Hazards
summary: The lithium-ion battery in the Galaxy Note7 smartphones can overheat and catch fire, posing a serious burn hazard to consumers. Units: About 1 million.

title: Huish Outdoors Recalls Buoyancy Control Devices (BCDs) Due to Drowning Hazard
summary: The buoyancy control devices can suddenly leak air causing a loss of flotation, posing a drowning hazard to scuba divers. Units: About 1,400 (in addition, about 50 were sold in Canada).

title: BLACK+DECKER™ Recalls Electric Blower/Vacuum/Mulchers Due to Laceration Hazard
summary: The fan cover can unlatch unexpectedly, posing a laceration hazard. Units: About 560,000 (in addition, about 20,000 were sold in Canada).

title: HAUS Mosquito Zapper LED Light Bulbs Recalled by Creative Sourcing Due to Shock Hazard
summary: The light bulb's base can separate from the connector, posing an electrical shock hazard. Units: About 11,500.

title: Toys 'R' Us Recalls Pacifier Clips Due to Choking Hazard; Sold Exclusively at Babies 'R' Us and Toys 'R' Us
summary: The pacifier clip's spring mechanism can break and release small parts, posing a choking hazard. Units: About 53,000.

title: Walmart Recalls Tripod Stools Due to Fall Hazard
summary: The plastic collar that connects the three legs can break, posing a fall hazard to consumers. Units: About 2,600.

title: Advanced Sports International Recalls Bicycles Due to Fall Hazard
summary: The top clamp of the seat post can crack, posing a fall hazard to the user. Units: About 3,000.

title: GTHI Recalls Ice Tools Due to Fall Hazard (Recall Alert)
summary: The head of the ice tool can detach from the shaft, posing a fall hazard to climbers. Units: About 220.

title: SmartPool Recalls Pool Alarms Due to Failure to Alert Consumers
summary: The ON/OFF activation switch on the pool alarm is reversed, which can cause the alarm to fail to alert consumers if a child enters the water. Units: About 1,600.

title: Infant Carriers Recalled Due to Fall Hazard; Manufactured By Lenny Lamb
summary: The internal stitching on the infant carrier is missing, posing a fall hazard to children. Units: About 900 (in addition, about 600 were sold in Canada).

title: Denon Recalls Rechargeable Battery Packs Due to Fire and Burn Hazards
summary: The battery can overheat, posing a fire and burn hazards Units: About 3,400 (in addition, 240 were sold in Canada).
